claims.statement: For every arity-2/3/4 ordinary path-star with m >= 100, every represented tip branch i, and every integer k with 1 <= k and 2k <= N+2, (h+1) U_i[k] C[k] + (k+1)(h-k+1)(E[k]C[k]-E[k+1]C[k-1]) > 0, with zero-extended coefficients.
claims.scope: Proposed retained subcase only: m >= 100, the full registered guarded k band, and represented tip branches. No actual first-descent or selector premise. This does not cover m <= 99, the endpoint, selected payment, or arbitrary trees.
claims.reason: Adversarial review found no hidden premise in the m >= 100 analytic proof. The low-rank support boundary, high-band arity ordering and parity midpoint constants, positive size-one Jensen block, strict Taylor bound, C ratio-floor sign, positive denominator clearing, and final deficit margin all check. Independent exact arithmetic replay confirms the rational constants. The composed family-specific tail remains informal; the formal Jensen theorem and C2/C3 lemmas are ingredients, not a formal award for this claim.

limitations: The universal analytic composition has not been Lean-verified; only cited component theorems have formal verification.
The all-m registered surplus remains unresolved for m <= 99.
This claim does not by itself establish endpoint comparisons, selected payment, the primary predicate, or any arbitrary-tree conclusion.
